revision_notes: Light check surfaced authoritative sources describing a genuinely ambiguous situation, so this was escalated to the full path but not scored with confidence. Historically Tanzania maintained a separate cadastral survey register (spatial/parcel descriptions) and a title/deeds register (ownership) (cadastraltemplate.org; UNIGIS thesis). However, the World-Bank-funded ILMIS/e-Ardhi modernisation programme has an explicit component ('Registration and Cadastral Data Integration') merging cadastral and title/registration data into a single dataset within one system, and per a 2025 World Bank Implementation Completion Report this is only rolled out in 14 of an originally planned 40 districts. It is therefore unclear whether the current position is best described as a 'separate' cadastral register, a partially merged one, or fully integrated, depending on location. Flagged for human review given the genuine ambiguity rather than guessed.
